hyperedges.label: BHPO search → retrain → evaluate → sweep → figures pipeline
Evaluation metric suite consumed by 05_evaluate/06_run_sweep (NRMSE, R2, MAE, BA, ICC, conservation)
solve_stokes internal helper chain (mesh build → BC marking → WSS extraction → export)
Physics-enforcement fixes E (wall-biased sampling), A (hard SDF no-slip), B (vector potential), D (self-adaptive loss weights) wired through trainer/networks/losses/inference
Synthetic MRI forward-operator chain: voxel grid construction -> node assignment -> averaging -> Gaussian noise -> MRIObservation
AnXplore mesh load -> boundary-face extraction -> outward-normal orientation -> mesh quality stats
Phase 3 mandatory test suite (anxplore_loader, mri_operator, losses, inference, bhpo) gating phase completion per CLAUDE.md §7
Test files added/extended specifically to cover Fixes A/B/D/E (hard SDF, vector potential, self-adaptive loss, wall-biased sampling)
Hydra config groups composed by config.yaml — geometry, cfd, mri, model, bhpo — selected per pipeline script invocation
Top-level project documentation set: README, CLAUDE.md, configs/README, tests/README, requirements.txt
MRI voxel-size resolution sweep (0.5/1.0/1.5/2.0/2.5 mm configs)
Fixes E, A, B, D — combined physics-structural NRMSE improvement programme
BHPO acceleration chain: Optuna TPE + MPS auto-detect + adjusted trial budget

Top-level project documentation set: README, CLAUDE.md, configs/README, tests/README, requirements.txt
